title: Plane crashes
content: Has anyone else here seen the plane crashes? I’ve both seen them, and been on planes that are going down. I often board a plane, get seated, take off, and then start to fall down. I’ve never actually been in a crash though. One crashed into the mall/airport outside, and just sits there nose into the ground, smoking from the tail. Funnily enough, I have this overwhelming feeling this was the plane I was on when it crashed, but woke up before it hit the ground, so now I just see it there. I often point out “oh that was the plane I was on!” The other one I’ve seen crashing is over the beach with the mountains in the distance. I’m always sitting on the brick wall when this happens. This one is always strange to see, as it’s flying so peacefully overhead before just randomly nosediving into the ocean.
